summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates installer host info to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: package.json's postinstall hook runs index.js, which POSTs the installer's absolute file path (leaking the home directory / OS username), Node.js version, and platform/architecture to a hardcoded Discord webhook (discord.com/api/webhooks/1530599209269465319/...). The same code sits at module top level, so the beacon also fires on require()/import. The webhook URL is split into two concatenated string literals at call time — a lightweight evasion of registry secret scanners with no functional purpose. The package's README self-describes as a 'typo' educational package, consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat beacon rather than a legitimate library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
